fact_english: Platymantis forest frogs, found mostly in the Philippines, lay their eggs out of water, and tiny froglets hatch directly, skipping the tadpole stage.

lines.speaker: INDIO
lines.text: May mga palakang-gubat sa Pilipinas, ang Platymantis, na hindi na dumadaan sa pagiging butete!

lines.speaker: USMAN
lines.text: Itlog, tapos maliit na palaka agad. Walang awkward stage.

after_text: Bakit ka nandito, anak ng tao?
why_here: After the giant's 'Bakit ka nandito, anak ng tao?': Indio's answer comes after the break.
